$comment: Machine-readable record of every third-party source transferred into this package. scripts/check-vendored-licenses.ts fails CI when a required file here is missing. Adding vendored code without adding an entry is itself a failure: the check requires every directory under THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES to be declared.

sources.upstreamNoticeEvidence: git ls-tree -r --name-only 63cd9b9c2ad19b9941a763be3d5cfcbd9bc13b25 lists no NOTICE file anywhere in the tree, so the Apache-2.0 section 4(d) obligation to reproduce one does not arise.
